SourceString: Actions are activities you perform personally.
To practice additional trades, obtain their licenses from the respective {B_GUILD_C}guild{##}.
Tasks are jobs carried out by {CHAR_CITVSWOR_C}workers{##}. Assign workers based on the {S_C}skills{##} required to ensure higher {CHAR_PRO_C}productivity{##} and fewer {ACC_C}accidents{##}.
Improving your own skills also helps, as a {CHAR_PRO_SKIEMP_C}skilled employer{##} gives better direction.
Outdoor tasks function like regular {A_ACT_C}tasks{##}, but workers must leave the premises, complete their work on site, and return.
While away, they are exposed to the conditions of the {C_QUA_C}quarter{##} — higher {QUA_CRI_C}crime rates{##} increase the {ACC_CHAACC_C}chance of accidents{##}.
Add bees to an empty hive and give your new colony a place to call home. Once settled, they can get to work doing what bees do best.
Submit the necessary papers and have your {T_C}title{##} recognized by the city. Your {CHAR_WEA_C}wealth{##} and earned {I_NOBRIG_C}rights{##} determine which rank you may claim.
Are you sure you want to withdraw your application for office?
Apply and await the {O_ELE_C}election{##}. A touch of {S_RHE_C}rhetoric{##} and the appointers' good {CHAR_STA_C}opinion{##} of you tend to sway matters — sometimes more than merit.
Test your {S_COM_C}martial{##} skill in the service of a noble. You must complete two quests before you are granted {I_NOBRIG_C}Nobility Rights{##}.
If you are successful in this task, you gain the {I_NOBRIG_C}right{##} to call yourself a {T_NOB_C}noble{##} in all but name. Formal recognition still requires an official application.
Test your {S_RHE_C}rhetoric{##} skill in the service of a noble. You'll have to complete three quests before you may request {I_NOBRIG_C}Nobility Rights{##}.
Court service requires time to build trust, prove discretion, and demonstrate you're worthy of elevation. There are two more tasks to go before the sweet {I_NOBRIG_C}Nobility Rights{##}.
You may finally request {I_NOBRIG_C}Nobility Rights{##}, then you can formally apply for a {T_NOB_C}noble title{##}, provided you have all that {CHAR_WEA_C}wealth{##}.
Buy your way in — no service, no sweat. {I_NOBRIG_C}Nobility Rights{##} are granted outright.
Send thugs to attack a cart. Easy profit if it's {A_HIRESC_C}unguarded{##} — otherwise, expect a {CO_COM_C}fight{##}.
Explore the city — you'll find plenty of other actions waiting for you.
Approach the Robber Baron and ask whether they have a few spare blades to lend. Offer a modest purse and some passable weapons, and you will receive a {I_ROBCON_01_C}contract{##}.

They are rough, loud, and not particularly bright — but more than enough to {A_ATKCAR_C}attack{##} an unguarded cart, and perhaps bold enough to test their luck against {A_HIRESC_C}light protection{##}.

Present yourself before the Robber Baron and request a dependable crew from their ranks. With respectable coin and reliable steel set forth, you will be granted a {I_ROBCON_02_C}contract{##} binding seasoned outlaws to your cause.
They know their trade and move with purpose, well suited to {A_ATKCAR_C}attack{##} most carts and handle {A_HIRESC_C}moderate resistance{##} without hesitation.

Stand before the Robber Baron with generous tribute and finely crafted weapons, and ask for their finest men. If they are satisfied, a {I_ROBCON_03_C}contract{##} will be placed in your hands — commanding their most disciplined and capable operatives.
These are no common brigands. They excel at {A_ATKCAR_C}confronting{##} well-guarded carts and overcoming {A_HIRESC_C}serious resistance{##}.

When diplomacy fails, there is always plan bee. Unleash a {A_TRAKILBEE_C}trained Killer Bee{##} on someone who has earned your displeasure. Whoever you send it after is in for something {ST_CHR_BEESTU_C}painful{##} and deeply unpleasant.
Some give out of pity, others from guilt — both spend the same. {S_RHE_C}rhetoric{##} knows which heartstrings to pull.
Pass on {CR_EVI_C}evidence{##} to damage another's {CHAR_STA_C}opinion{##} of the sinner. {S_RHE_C}Rhetoric{##} matters — yours to persuade, theirs to withstand.
Use {CR_EVI_C}evidence{##} to demand payment in exchange for silence. {CR_EVISTR_C}Greater proof{##} demands greater payment.
Strong {CR_EVI_C}evidence{##} has a way of pushing {O_TYP_CIVOFF_C}officials{##} into {A_RESOFF_C}early retirement{##}.
{CR_EVI_C}Leverage{##} ensures their agreement in all matters — for now. They stand with you, bound by circumstance rather than belief.
Slip them silver and hope they forget their principles. Some cost more than others, unless {S_STE_C}roguery{##} is part of your charm.
Upgrade this building to unlock new actions, improvements, and additional opportunities.
Information changes hands easily over ale. Pay up, and someone's secret becomes your leverage.
Pay the church to lighten the weight of your {CR_CRI_C}sins{##}. Coin cleans the conscience faster than prayer.
Any law changes only take effect the following turn.
Do your part in reinforcing civic order by throwing things at the pilloried.
Warm the honey and pass it through a cloth, leaving wax, grit, and lesser things behind until only the purest sweetness remains.
Choose a quarter in need of attention and get your hands dirty. Clear away filth, patch up what has fallen into ruin, and leave the streets in better shape than you found them.
Brush off the dust, tighten a hinge — a little care now spares costly repairs later.
Gather the wax from your combs. Honey is not the only thing worth harvesting.
The harvest is {A_COLCONHON_C}spoiled{##}, but the {I_CONHON_C}honey{##} may still have its uses. Harvest it anyway!
The hive has had a fine season, and the comb is brimming with honey. Reap the reward!
The colony had a poor season, leaving only a modest amount of honey to gather. Harvest what you can, and mind the {ST_CHR_BEESTU_C}stings{##}!
Taint the hive and leave its colony {ST_STR_BEESIC_C}sick{##} and struggling. Bee warned: the colony may {ST_CHR_BEESTU_C}fight back{##}.
Choose someone to court and secure your {CHAR_DYN_C}legacy{##}. Marrying down is cheap, but marrying up takes effort.

A partner with a {TR_STRBLO_C}strong{##} or {TR_EXCBLO_C}exceptional bloodline{##} is more likely to produce {S_C}skilled{##} {CHAR_HEI_C}heirs{##}, while a {CHAR_HP_C}healthier{##} one will prove more {CHAR_FER_C}fertile{##}.
Wooing someone who {CHAR_STA_C}thinks little of you{##} is harder — but not impossible. And remember: courting is a race. The best candidates rarely have only one suitor.
Thoughtful choices win hearts faster than empty flattery.
Higher {T_C}titles{##} expect finer gifts — and the greater the difference between you, the harder they are to impress.
Send Gift to Your Love Interest
Whether the match has proven disappointing, too expensive, or simply outpaced by a better prospect, you may withdraw at any time.
If {S_RHE_C}rhetoric{##} is your forte, words can do what coin cannot.
Create items by combining materials from your {B_STOROO_C}storeroom{##}. \nWorkers with higher {S_HAN_C}handicraft{##} skill perform these tasks more efficiently.
To lay a curse on someone, you must offer an item in sacrifice.
Sneak into a rival hive and smoke out the colony before anyone can stop you. Bee warned: a hive under attack tends to defend itself.
Invite them to dine — impressing the common is cheap, impressing the {T_C}wealthy{##} is not. Either way {CHAR_STA_C}favors{##} are best served after supper.
Remove the master and run the building yourself. The master will be free to manage other buildings, provided you find their performance and attitude acceptable.
They say that when you want something done right, you better do it yourself. In this case, it's probably better to take matters into your own hands.

Has a fellow or lass slighted you, with an unkind remark or a cross look? Let steel speak for your honor. \n\nIn {CO_COM_C}combat{##}, your {S_COM_C}martial{##} skill and choice of {I_TYP_COMEQU_C}equipment{##} decide the outcome.
Select a piece of armor from your Personal Inventory
Give a worker a piece of armor from your inventory to protect themselves in dangerous situations.
Any currently equipped weapon or armor will be discarded and replaced by this one.
Select a weapon from your Personal Inventory
Give a worker a weapon from your inventory to better defend themselves when faced with danger.
Send spies to dig up {CR_EVI_C}evidence{##}, or use your own {S_STE_C}roguery{##} to expose what others would keep buried — every secret makes fine leverage.
Send in a professional. If there is {CR_EVI_C}evidence{##} to be found, they will find it, and probably learn far more than you paid them to.
Hire a dubious pair of eyes to sniff out some {CR_EVI_C}evidence{##}. Cheap, but not exactly reassuring.
Hire a seasoned spy to dig up {CR_EVI_C}evidence{##} without drawing too much attention.
You can spy on a maximum of 5 characters.
You have no ongoing espionage operations at the moment.
Get your own hands dirty and gather {CR_EVI_C}evidence{##} yourself.
Are you sure you want to stop spying?
Remove the bees from the hive permanently. Whatever your reasons, the colony will not be coming back.
Wake the {ST_STR_BEEHIB_C}sleepy{##} colony with a good meal and help them buzz back into {ST_STR_BEEACT_C}action{##}.
Instruct your workers to discreetly listen in on patrons' conversations. You never know what they might overhear. Careful attention may uncover useful {CR_EVI_C}evidence{##}.
Send your more {S_STE_C}roguish{##} thieves to plant evidence on another, shifting the blame for a {CR_CRI_C}crime{##} you have committed onto them.

When you gain enough {CHAR_XP_C}experience{##}, you can advance your Mastery Grade in your {P_C}profession{##} and unlock important benefits — such as being able to level up your {B_TYP_OCCBUI_C}business{##}.
Search the land for useful ingredients. Skilled hands — those with strong {S_HAN_C}handicraft{##} skill — bring back the best finds.
Lean in and ignite a little discord between two people, dragging their {CHAR_STA_C}opinion{##} of one another downward.

Choose a member of your family to secure an {P_ALC_C}Alchemist{##}'s License. They will then be able to serve as the {B_OCC_MGR_C}Master{##} of your {B_OCC_ALC_C}Alchemist's Lab{##}, while you turn your attention to other pursuits.
License a Family Member as Alchemist
Appoint a Family Member as Graveyard Warden
Choose a member of your family to swear service as a {P_GUA_C}Guard{##}, allowing them to take up the {B_OCC_MGR_C}duties{##} of the {B_OCC_GUA_C}barracks{##} while you focus your efforts elsewhere.
Enlist a Family Member as Guard

Choose a member of your family to secure an {P_INN_C}Innkeeper{##}'s License. They will then be able to serve as the {B_OCC_MGR_C}Master{##} of your {B_OCC_INN_C}inn{##}, keeping the ale flowing while you attend to other matters.
License a Family Member as Innkeeper

Choose a member of your family to secure a {P_JOI_C}Joiner{##}'s License. They will then be able to serve as the {B_OCC_MGR_C}Master{##} of your {B_OCC_JOI_C}joiner's workshop{##}, while you turn your attention to other pursuits.
License a Family Member as Joiner
License a Family Member as Moneylender

Choose a member of your family to secure a {P_PER_C}Perfumer{##}'s License. They will then be able to serve as the {B_OCC_MGR_C}Master{##} of your {B_OCC_PER_C}perfumery{##}, while you turn your attention to other pursuits.
License a Family Member as Perfumer

Choose a member of your family to take the oath of a {P_PRE_C}Preacher{##}, allowing them to carry out their holy duties as the {B_OCC_MGR_C}head{##} of your {B_OCC_PRE_C}church{##}, while you devote yourself to other affairs.
Ordain a Family Member as Preacher

Choose a member of your family accepted among the {P_ROB_C}Robbers{##}. Once they have proven themselves, they will be able to {B_OCC_MGR_C}take charge{##} of your {B_OCC_ROB_C}criminal enterprise{##} while you focus your attention elsewhere.
Initiate a Family Member as Robber

Choose a member of your family to secure a {P_SMI_C}Smith{##}'s License. They will then be able to serve as the {B_OCC_MGR_C}Master{##} of your {B_OCC_SMI_C}smithy{##}, while you turn your attention to other pursuits.
License a Family Member as Smith

Choose a member of your family to secure a {P_MAS_C}Stone Mason{##}'s License. They will then be able to serve as the {B_OCC_MGR_C}Master{##} of your {B_OCC_MAS_C}masonry business{##}, while you turn your attention to other pursuits.
License a Family Member as Stone Mason

Choose a member of your family to secure a {P_TAI_C}Tailor{##}'s License. They will then be able to serve as the {B_OCC_MGR_C}Master{##} of your {B_OCC_TAI_C}tailor's workshop{##}, while you turn your attention to other pursuits.
License a Family Member as Tailor
Choose a member of your family accepted among the thieves. They will then be able to take {B_OCC_MGR_C}charge{##} of your {B_OCC_THI_C}Hideout{##}, while you keep your hands free for other pursuits.
Initiate a Family Member as Thief
License a Family Member as Trader
Establish a Troupe for a Family Member
Send guards to patrol a {C_QUA_C}quarter{##}. A visible presence tends to lower {QUA_CRI_C}crime rate{##} and calm rising {QUA_UNR_C}unrest{##}.

Sit with someone in the workshop for a chat. A little wine, a little gossip, and suddenly you know things you didn't know you needed.\nA more {B_PARAM_ATT_C}attractive{##} shop and better {CHAR_STA_C}opinion{##} of you make them far more willing to join you.
Treat the {ST_STR_BEESIC_C}sick{##} colony with a little {I_ROYJEL_C}Royal Jelly{##}. They should be back on their wings in no time.
Hire mercenaries to {CO_COM_C}defend{##} your cart against {A_ATKCAR_C}lurking robbers{##} during its journey.
Assign a Dynasty Member as Alchemist Master

Put your business in the hands of a capable master. You can even choose a family member, provided they hold the proper {P_C}license{##}. They'll handle the day-to-day details you don't want to think about, while the business — and its profits — remain yours.
The Master receives a percentage of the business's profits.

You are always the best person to manage your own businesses. But as your wealth and influence grow, so do the demands on your time. When you can no longer tend to every enterprise yourself, put them in hands you trust.
It's a fine way to prepare the next generation for the day you're... no longer available for consultation.
They'll learn the trade, handle the day-to-day business, and keep things running automatically while you put your feet up and collect the profits. Everyone wins.
But mind who you put in charge.

Before you can appoint them as {B_OCC_MGR_C}master{##}, they must first join the {B_GUILD_C}guild{##}, and you should make sure to train them accordingly. Workers are more {CHAR_PRO_C}productive{##} at {A_ACT_CRA_C}crafting{##} when their master is also skilled in {S_HAN_C}handicraft{##}, while other {A_ACT_C}tasks{##} may benefit from different {S_C}skills{##}.
Assign a Dynasty Member as Master
Assign a Dynasty Member as Guard Master
Assign a Dynasty Member as Innkeeper Master
Assign a Dynasty Member as Joiner Master
Assign a Dynasty Member as Mason Master
Assign a Dynasty Member as Perfumer Master
Assign a Dynasty Member as Preacher Master
Assign a Dynasty Member as Robber Master
Assign a Dynasty Member as Smith Master
Assign a Dynasty Member as Tailor Master
Assign a Dynasty Member as Thief Master
Strengthen a building with new buttresses and fresh mortar — work suited to strong {S_HAN_C}handicraft{##} skills.
Reinforce a cart with fresh beams and tightened bindings — best done by skilled {S_HAN_C}handicraft{##} hands.
Have stone masons level the road and lay new paving stones — work best done with solid {S_HAN_C}handicraft{##}.
Select a skill to improve by one point.
Send your most {S_STE_C}street-smart{##} guard to inspect someone's business. You may uncover {CR_EVI_C}evidence{##} of the owner's misdeeds.
You don't raise your voice. You don't make threats. You just let them feel it — your status, your power, your reach. A silent reminder: ‘I'm above you. Act accordingly.'
Tell them their wit is smaller than their signet ring. The reply may come in the form of a duel.
Words can wound deeper than blades. Craft a biting satire to shame your target in public. The sharper your {S_RHE_C}rhetoric{##}, the sharper the sting.
If you seek a little inspiration, start with a simple tune.\nYou might get ONE of these results:
Every tavern song ends with someone getting hit — you take notes.

Jokes, songs, whatever they're good at — put the worker on stage. You'll want to {A_ACT_TRALIVPER_C}rehearse{##} them first, as good {S_RHE_C}rhetoric{##} is bound to {B_PARAM_ATT_C}draw a bigger crowd{##}.
Authorize reconstruction to address damage and restore basic order.
Intervene to contain unrest and restore public calm.
Step in and force a little peace between two stubborn souls, raising their {CHAR_STA_C}opinion{##} of each other.
No actions are currently available for the selected building.
Your presence alone stirs effort. {CHAR_PRO_C}Productivity{##} rises when the boss is watching.

A servant visits the home of a troubled soul, offering absolution for one of their {CR_CRI_C}sins{##}. The better their {S_RHE_C}rhetoric{##} and the less {CR_SEV_C}severe{##} the crime, the higher the chance of grace — and if forgiven, heaven answers in return with {CHAR_AP}.
Give the workers a little extra. Let them think they've found something worth staying for.
Fumes for insects, powders for rats, and something “special” for the stubborn ones.\nBest handled by workers skilled in {S_HAN_C}handicraft{##}.
Have yourself examined by a physician. Stand still. Try not to ask questions.
If you are truly {ST_CHR_SIC_C}ill{##} or {ST_INJ_C}injured{##}, we recommend {A_HEA_C}Seek a Cure{##} instead.

Something has caught your eye — and it is not yours. Set your thieves upon it: the more {S_STE_C}silver-tongued{##} they are, the greater their odds — so long as the current owner stays none the wiser and proves {S_STE_C}easy to fool{##}.
Send thieves to a {C_QUA_C}quarter{##} to lighten purses. The more {S_STE_C}roguish{##} the crew, the richer the haul.
Send your thieves to pickpocket a {C_QUA_C}quarter{##}. The more {S_STE_C}roguish{##} they are and the more populated the area, the greater the haul.
Spend time in prayer. The church may not answer, but something always does.
Offer a prayer for someone, asking fortune to lean their way.
Say a gentle prayer for your children, wishing them {SE_BLE_C}blessings{##} and strong {CHAR_HP_C}health{##}.
A moment is taken to ask for safe hands in a business of your choosing, sparing your workers from {ACC_C}accidents{##}.
Listen to the preaching — or stand up and object to the preacher's words.
Tune the room, set the mood, and let the bard work their magic. A good performance draws customers, lifts your workers' spirits, and carries your name a little farther across town.
Use {CR_EVI_C}evidence{##} to press charges. A {CR_TRI_C}trial{##} against the accused will begin next {C_TRN_C}turn{##}.
Some duties require privacy. A quiet moment together may strengthen your {CHAR_STA_C}bond{##}, and possibly bless your household with an {CHAR_HEI_C}heir{##}.
Recognize hard-earned experience with a promotion. They become more {CHAR_PRO_C}productive{##}, less prone to {B_PARAM_ACCPRO_ACC}accidents{##} — and worth the higher wage.
Send your {S_COM_C}toughest{##} guards to protect the Town Hall. The council rewards the service — more generously when the quarter's {QUA_REP_C}reputation{##} is worth protecting.

A short civic duty — nothing grand. The better your {S_RHE_C}rhetoric{##}, the better the pay. And who knows — you might even make {CHAR_STA_C}friends{##} — or enemies — among the {O_CHA_TOWSER_C}Town Servants{##}.
Choose someone below you in your {O_CHA_C}chamber{##} and remove them from {O_TYP_CIVOFF_C}office{##}.
If you think your {CHAR_HEI_C}heir{##} is ready to assume the dynasty, you may bid this cruel world farewell and let them take up the mantle.
Gameplay continues with your {CHAR_HEI_C}heir{##} as the active character. No heir means game over.
If your time has come, you may choose to resign from your {O_TYP_CIVOFF_C}office{##}.
Are you sure you want to resign?
Send your robbers to lie in wait and waylay a passing cart. Poorly {A_HIRESC_C}protected{##} transports are easy prey — others may put up a {CO_COM_C}fight{##}.
Find a high-{B_PARAM_VAL_C}value{##} building with little {B_PARAM_BURPRO_C}security{##}, and send your most {S_STE_C}roguish{##} rogues to take what they can carry.
Find a high-{B_PARAM_VAL_C}value{##} building with little {B_PARAM_BURPRO_C}security{##}, and send your most {S_STE_C}roguish{##} robbers to take what they can carry.
Find a high-{B_PARAM_VAL_C}value{##} building with little {B_PARAM_BURPRO_C}security{##}, and send your most {S_STE_C}roguish{##} thieves to take what they can carry.
Pay the right hands to cause a little chaos — fire, damage, disruption. {S_STE_C}roguery{##} helps you find someone who won't botch the job… or name names.
Perfumers sweeten the air, the mood, and the profits. Few resist a place this {B_PARAM_ATT_C}inviting{##}. \nPick a worker with strong {S_HAN_C}handicraft{##} skills for the job.
If you are {ST_CHR_SIC_C}sick{##} or {ST_INJ_C}injured{##}, the physician offers the most effective treatment.\nLeeches might be involved.
Choose who will inherit your titles, property, and wealth when your current character dies. An {CHAR_HEI_C}heir{##} keeps the game going and your {CHAR_DYN_C}dynasty{##} alive.
Someone will pay for the truth. You might as well be the one collecting.\nThe higher the culprit's {T_C}title{##} and the {CR_EVISTR_C}stronger{##} the evidence, the heavier the purse.
Send coin with a letter of support. \nIt may serve as thanks, reconciliation, or simple kindness — a gesture offered freely, without expectation.
Dispatch spies to gather whatever secrets the town is careless enough to spill.
Clear the charges and order the {ST_CHR_IMP_C}prisoner{##}'s release. The freed soul will be {CHAR_STA_C}grateful{##} — others may not be.

Send your workers to someone's home to take their measurements and craft a personalized style. \n\nWith skilled {S_HAN_C}handicraft{##}, that touch of refinement can lift their {CHAR_STA_C}reputation{##} in the eyes of the town.

Choose your ammunition, take aim at any building in the city, and let the cannon speak. A well-placed shot can wreak havoc on its target, with different ammunition bringing its own unpleasant surprises. Miss or hit, however, firing a cannon at your fellow citizens is difficult to overlook—and even harder to explain to the authorities.
Put on a performance to earn tips and public applause. Especially popular among common folk and workers.

A dangerous guard duty, brief but {CHAR_ENE_C}demanding{##}.\nPay scales with {S_COM_C}martial{##} skill, and reducing {QUA_CRI_C}crime{##} may earn you {CHAR_STA_C}favor{##} among the {O_CHA_TOWBAI_C}Town Bailiffs{##}.
A seat among the regulars buys more than company — it buys the kind of information only ale can loosen. Stay long enough and someone will spill more than their drink.
Love is a fragile thing. It would be a shame if something… happened to it. Sow doubt between two lovers and {S_RHE_C}convince{##} them they deserve better.

Dirty clothes, strange noises, secret lovers — people-watch and share your “valuable findings” with the {O_CHA_INF_C}informants{##}. No proof is required.

Strong {S_STE_C}roguery{##} increases the pay and may even uncover real {CR_EVI_C}evidence{##} of a crime.

Not everyone appreciates being talked about, but {CHAR_STA_C}allies{##} in this chamber are useful.

Dirty clothes, strange noises, secret lovers — people-watch and share your “valuable findings” with the {O_CHA_INF_C}informants{##}. No proof is required.

Strong {S_NEG_C}negotiation{##} helps you get a better price for your gossip and may even turn up real {CR_EVI_C}evidence{##} of a crime.

Not everyone appreciates being talked about, but {CHAR_STA_C}allies{##} in this chamber are useful.
Buy a drink, share a laugh, make a friend — or a future favor.
Ask your spouse to lend a hand in the business. Prosperity grows in the ledgers, if not always in the {ST_CHR_FERDEC_C}bedroom{##}.
Steal the honey before its keeper can enjoy it, but mind the bees. They know a stranger when they see one.

Send your most {S_STE_C}roguish{##} thieves to a shop or marketplace to steal an item. The only thing in their way is the building's {B_PARAM_BURPRO_C}security{##} — provided the owner wasn't foolish enough to neglect it.
Send a priest to carry your faith through the streets. The more convincing their {S_RHE_C}rhetoric{##}, the richer the offerings returned.
Send workers to strengthen a building's weak points with sturdier bars and hinges — work best done by those with strong {S_HAN_C}handicraft{##} skills.

Keep patrols moving and guards visible on the streets. It will keep crime in check and make would-be troublemakers think twice. For the bigger threats, however, you may want to leave the heavy lifting to someone with more authority.
Flood the streets with patrols. Give criminals nowhere to breathe. Crime will buckle under the pressure, but the people may tire of guards on every corner and boots at every door.
Gather the town's dues. Some pay willingly. Others require encouragement.
Provide hands-on training to a worker. {CHAR_XP_C}Experience{##} gained brings them closer to {A_TEAEXP_C}promotion{##}.
Use what you know — and let them know you know it. With {CR_EVI_C}evidence{##} in hand and {S_RHE_C}rhetoric{##} to uphold it, the warning doesn't need repeating.
Within locked walls, suffering can be administered to those already stripped of {ST_CHR_IMP_C}freedom{##}.
Spend time together — skills are learned quickly at that age.
A parent's hand guides best — grandchildren have their own parents for that.
Assign guards to train in {S_COM_C}martial{##} skill. More discipline, stronger strikes, better chances in battle.
Assign robbers to train in {S_COM_C}martial{##} skill. Harder hits, tougher stance, and a clear advantage in battle.
Assign thieves to train in {S_COM_C}martial{##} skill. Harder hits, tougher stance, and a clear advantage in battle.
Turn your {ST_STR_BEEAGI_C}agitated{##} bees into tiny, winged assassins.
Send a worker to rehearse so they're ready to {A_ACT_LIVPER_C}take the stage{##} tonight. They can perform without it — but a {ST_CHR_TRALIVPER_C}stage-ready{##} act draws a bigger crowd.
Gain {CHAR_XP_C}experience{##} in your {P_C}profession{##} through focused training.
Choose a family member and put a weapon in their hands. Better they improve their {S_COM_C}martial{##} before they have need of it.
Select a skill to train by one point.
Put in the practice and improve your {S_HAN_C}handicraft{##}.
Choose a family member and lend them the tools to practise their {S_HAN_C}handicraft{##}. You will not be around to fix everything forever.
Learn how to strike a better bargain and improve your {S_NEG_C}negotiation{##}.
Choose a family member and teach them to hold their own at the bargaining table, improving their {S_NEG_C}negotiation{##}.

Assign robbers to train in {S_STE_C}roguery{##}. Better deception, quicker reactions — and fewer surprises during a clash.

Invest in a worker's training, hoping they will repay the effort.

Hire thugs to beat up a chosen rival. It's less about random thuggery and more about strategic intimidation — if you're skilled in {S_COM_C}martial{##}, you understand the language of force, even when you outsource it.
Try to catch a {I_BEEQUE_C}Queen Bee{##}. With her, you can build a {B_PER_BEEHIV_C}hive{##} — and let hundreds of tiny workers make money for you.

Try to catch a {I_BEEQUE_C}Queen Bee{##}. Once you have built a {B_PER_BEEHIV_C}hive{##}, you will need the queen to {A_ADDBEE_C}lure{##} her swarm of tiny but dedicated workers who will make {I_HON_C}honey{##} and {I_BEEWAX_C}beeswax{##} for you if you treat them well.
Queen bees are scarce. As {B_PER_BEEHIV_C}hives{##} spread through the city, unclaimed queens grow harder to find.
Securing one is a matter of {S_C}skill{##} — bees do not give in without a {S_COM_C}fight{##}.
Obtain an {P_ALC_C}Alchemist{##}'s License and pursue experiments where curiosity is rewarded and explosions are occasionally educational.
Swear service as a {P_GUA_C}Guard{##} and uphold order.
Secure an {P_INN_C}Innkeeper{##}'s License and preside over a house where ale is poured and secrets travel freely.
Secure a {P_JOI_C}Joiner{##}'s License and practice a craft where proper joints hold firm — without depending on someone else's iron.
Secure a {P_PER_C}Perfumer{##}'s License and trade in fragrances refined enough to improve even the city's less fortunate aromas.
Swear the oath and gain the right to practice as a {P_PRE_C}Preacher{##} — within the holy bounds of doctrine.
The road favors the ruthless. To command a band of {P_ROB_C}robbers{##}, prove you are one of them.
Obtain a {P_SMI_C}Smith{##}'s License and work at the forge, where iron yields only to heat, strength, and patience.
Obtain a {P_MAS_C}Stone Mason{##}'s License and commit to working in straight lines — some of us find them comforting.
Obtain a {P_TAI_C}Tailor{##}'s License and shape garments to fit both body and ambition.
To run a {B_OCC_THI_C}Hideout{##}, you must gain acceptance in a circle where trust is thin, pockets are lighter, and attention is best avoided.
Assign a worker with strong {S_NEG_C}negotiation{##} to the bar. They sell goods from your {B_STOFRO_C}storefront{##} at higher prices. You may want to invest in a {B_IMP_INN_BAR_C}larger bar{##}.
Search the wrecked caravan — broken scraps still earn a little coin. Keep salvaging it until there's nothing left to take.

Give a young child a home and watch them grow into the family. You will have plenty of time to care for them, teach them, and gently steer them toward becoming exactly the sort of heir you had in mind.

Are your children ungrateful, useless, or showing no sign of becoming the respectable continuation of your dynasty you had hoped for? Perhaps you have no heir at all, or simply do not fancy waiting another decade for someone to become useful. An older child will not need quite so many years before they can pull their weight. Or perhaps you are simply feeling charitable. Either way, someone gets a family.
Choose a promising match for a member of your {CHAR_DYN_C}dynasty{##} and set the courtship in motion. Love may follow. If not, a useful marriage will do.
Arrange Courtship for a Family Member

Has your relative fallen in love with someone who doesn't quite fit the family's plans? How inconvenient. Perhaps they could find someone better. Perhaps you could. Have a word with them before they start climbing balconies, exchanging secret vows, or declaring they'd rather die than live without their beloved.

You catch more flies with honey than vinegar, or so they say. As for troublesome relatives, a little {I_CONHON_C}tainted honey{##} works wonders. They'll never have a bad word to say about you again. Just be careful who gets a taste. It would be terribly embarrassing to poison yourself.
A little intimidation can go a long way when dealing with an unwanted relative. Convince them that life would be much more pleasant somewhere far, far away.

Family is forever. What a dreadful thought. Fortunately, a little ink can accomplish what years of family arguments could not. One signature, and your troublesome relative is no longer your concern. Now, who gets their inheritance?
What greater honor than to dedicate one's life to God? Your relative may disagree, but that's hardly the point. A life of prayer, chastity, and humble service awaits them. Such a noble sacrifice!

Have a member of your dynasty run for office. Their chances of winning depend on {S_RHE_C}rhetoric{##} and the appointers' {CHAR_STA_C}opinion{##} of them, but a relative in office can open doors, turn a blind eye, and ensure that certain family interests are never overlooked.

Gold may buy the finest gifts, but no fortune can match the sincerity of a heartfelt poem. Whether rich or poor, when you've found the right person, a few honest words can mean more than all the riches in the world.
Flowers may fade, but the joy of receiving them can last much longer. After all, not everything beautiful needs to be practical or permanent.

What better way to show your devotion than a portrait of the beautiful family you could build together? A loving home, happy children, and a lifetime of shared memories, all lovingly painted before you've even had your first child.

Keep your beloved warm with a fine cloak embroidered with your family crest. A romantic gesture that offers comfort, elegance, and a gentle reminder to other suitors that your beloved is already spoken for.

A pair of matching rings, a symbol of two hearts joined together. With love and a little luck, they may become a treasured family heirloom, passed down through generations as a reminder of where it all began.

Nothing says good taste quite like a ridiculously large wheel of cheese with your initials carved into it. A splendid opportunity to flaunt your wealth and impress your beloved with your impeccable taste. In cheese, of course.
A finely crafted hairbrush adorned with precious jewels, a gift of elegance and refined taste. A beautiful way to remind your beloved that even the simplest daily rituals deserve a touch of luxury.

Immortalize the memory of your first date with a beautifully crafted tapestry, woven with exquisite detail and the finest threads. A truly elegant masterpiece that ensures every guest who enters your home can admire the intimate details of your budding romance.

A magnificent Arabian horse, prized for its beauty, grace, and noble pedigree. A gift of true prestige, worthy of someone whose heart you hope to win and whose company you wish to enjoy on many rides to come.
Give your beloved the luxury they deserve with a magnificent bathtub made of solid gold. After all, how could anyone feel truly cherished while enduring the indignity of bathing in anything less?

A hulking brown bear with thick, shaggy fur, fearsome claws, and a lovely ribbon tied around its neck. A rare and prestigious gift, worthy of royalty and certain to leave a lasting impression on your beloved.
Everyone enjoys a good laugh now and then.
Show off your musical talents with a heartfelt serenade. With a little luck, your audience might appreciate your performance as much as you do.
Engage your beloved in a spirited debate and attempt to impress them with your intellect. Just remember that winning an argument isn't necessarily the best way to win someone's heart.
Get to know your beloved by discussing their interests and sharing your own. It's much easier to find common ground with someone who's already fond of you.

Assign this cart to a building so everyone knows where it belongs. A little organization never hurt anyone, especially when there are several carts and buildings to keep track of. The assignment itself won't change how the cart operates, but if the building has a {B_OCC_MGR_C}master{##}, they'll know which cart is theirs to command and take control of its activities.
Unassign this cart from its building. The cart will continue working as usual, but the building's {B_OCC_MGR_C}master{##}, if there is one, will no longer be able to control it.

Welcome your little one into the Christian faith through the holy sacrament of baptism. Keep the name chosen by your spouse and ask for God's blessing upon your child. May the Lord watch over them throughout their life.

Every child deserves a name to carry through life, and perhaps you have a better one in mind. Choose a new name for your little one and have them baptized into the Christian faith. Your spouse may not appreciate the change, but surely Heaven won't mind!
Keep it simple and honest. Speak from the heart. What could possibly go wrong? I'm not nervous, you are!
Great feelings deserve grand words. Why speak plainly of something so extraordinary as love? Some are fortunate enough to find love. Others are fortunate enough to be loved by a poet.

Why build from scratch when someone has already done the hard work for you? Do you like the location? Is the building well-maintained enough to justify the price? Take a good look before you buy, for you can hardly cry foul play once the deal is struck!

Don't know how to sell a building in this economy? Leave it to the city! Their officials will handle the sale, you get your money immediately, and all the necessary deductions are already included in the price. How convenient!
Slip Away for a Quick Romp
The guests are busy celebrating, and surely no one will notice if the newlyweds disappear for a little while. There are, after all, certain marital duties that simply cannot wait.
Raise your cup and deliver a toast to love, friendship, and a prosperous future! Win the hearts of your guests with a few fine words and plenty of beer.
